title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 84
description: Ten questions on Psalms 84: longing for the courts of Yahweh, the blessed pilgrims, and a day in his courts better than a thousand.

questions.text: In verse 1, what does the psalmist call lovely?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!"

questions.text: For whom do the psalmist's heart and flesh cry out?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God."

questions.text: Which birds have found a home and a nest near God's altars?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself near your altars.

questions.text: What does verse 4 say those who dwell in God's house are always doing?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you."

questions.text: Through which valley do the pilgrims pass, making it a place of springs?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs.

questions.text: According to verse 7, how do they go?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "They go from strength to strength."

questions.text: A day in God's courts is better than what?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says a day in your courts is better than a thousand.

questions.text: What would the psalmist rather be in the house of his God?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says he would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of his God than dwell in the tents of wickedness.

questions.text: Verse 11 says Yahweh God is a sun and a what?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "Yahweh God is a sun and a shield."

questions.text: Who is called blessed in the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: "Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you."

answers.text: The man who lives in Zion
The man who brings many offerings
The man who trusts in Yahweh
